852550.name: HIS7
852550.summary: Enables glutaminase activity and imidazoleglycerol-phosphate synthase activity. Involved in L-histidine biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852557.name: MTC4
852557.summary: Located in lipid droplet and peroxisome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852561.name: SHG1
852561.summary: Contributes to histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in chromatin remodeling. Located in nucleus. Part of Set1C/COMPASS complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852565.name: SHM1
852565.summary: Enables glycine hydroxymethyltransferase activity. Involved in one-carbon metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer. Orthologous to human SHMT1 (serine hydroxymethyltransferase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852569.name: REI1
852569.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including budding cell bud growth; nucleocytoplasmic transport; and ribosomal large subunit biogenesis. Located in cytoplasm. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human ZNF622 (zinc finger protein 622). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852578.name: RIF1
852578.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; negative regulation of mitotic DNA replication initiation from late origin; and regulation of DNA stability. Located in chromosome, telomeric region. Part of shelterin complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852584.name: DUG2
852584.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and omega peptidase activity. Contributes to glutathione gamma-glutamate hydrolase. Involved in glutathione catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nuclear periphery. Part of glutathione hydrolase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852587.name: YBR284W
852587.summary: Predicted to be located in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852589.name: APE3
852589.summary: Enables aminopeptidase activity. Involved in protein catabolic process in the vacuole. Located in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852598.name: PCA1
852598.summary: Enables P-type cadmium transporter activity; copper ion binding activity; and proteasome binding activity. Involved in cadmium ion transport; intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis; and transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. Part of proteasome core complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852599.name: PHO89
852599.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and sodium:phosphate symporter activity. Involved in phosphate ion transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in basal ganglia calcification. Orthologous to human SLC20A1 (solute carrier family 20 member 1) and SLC20A2 (solute carrier family 20 member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852600.name: MAL33
852600.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852616.name: MTO1
852616.summary: Predicted to enable flavin adenine dinucleotide binding activity. Predicted to contribute to tRNA 5-taurinomethyluridine synthase activity. Involved in mitochondrial tRNA wobble uridine modification. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study nonsyndromic deafness. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 10. Orthologous to human MTO1 (mitochondrial tRNA translation optimization 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852617.name: ADE57
852617.description: bifunctional aminoimidazole ribotide synthase/glycinamide ribotide synthase
852617.otherdesignations: bifunctional aminoimidazole ribotide synthase/glycinamide ribotide synthase
852617.nomenclaturename: bifunctional aminoimidazole ribotide synthase/glycinamide ribotide synthase
852617.summary: Predicted to enable phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase activity and phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenine biosynthetic process and purine nucleotide biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human GART (phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase, phosphoribosylglycinamide synthetase, phosphoribosylaminoimidazole synthetase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852619.name: TAN1
852619.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. Involved in tRNA acetylation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human THUMPD1 (THUMP domain 1 NAT10 acetyltransferase adaptor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852624.name: VID30
852624.summary: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in negative regulation of gluconeogenesis; proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; and regulation of nitrogen utilization. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of GID complex. Orthologous to human RANBP10 (RAN binding protein 10) and RANBP9 (RAN binding protein 9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852638.name: FZF1
852638.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in cyanamide metabolic process and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852639.name: HXK2
852639.summary: Enables hexokinase activity. Involved in several processes, including hexose import across plasma membrane; hexose metabolic process; and regulation of transcription by glucose. Located in cytosol and mitochondrial membrane. Is active in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including anemia (multiple); artery disease (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); and retinitis pigmentosa (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GCK (glucokinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852640.name: RTG2
852640.summary: Enables phosphoprotein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including maintenance of DNA trinucleotide repeats; mitochondria-nucleus signaling pathway; and protein import into nucleus. Located in cytoplasm and euchromatin. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852657.name: CLG1
852657.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in positive regulation of macroautophagy. Part of cyclin-dependent protein kinase holoenzyme complex. Orthologous to human CNPPD1 (cyclin Pas1/PHO80 domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852660.name: VAM7
852660.summary: Enables SNAP receptor activity; phosphatidic acid binding activity; and phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Involved in several processes, including double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; macroautophagy; and vacuolar calcium ion homeostasis. Located in autophagosome membrane; fungal-type vacuole membrane; and phagophore assembly site. Part of SNARE complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852664.name: SIP2
852664.summary: Enables enzyme-substrate adaptor activity. Contributes to AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose starvation; invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and regulation of cellular response to glucose starvation. Located in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. Part of nucleotide-activated protein kinase complex. Orthologous to human PRKAB1 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit beta 1) and PRKAB2 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit beta 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852695.name: ATG1
852695.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to potassium ion starvation; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in several cellular components, including autophagosome membrane; phagophore; and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of Atg1/ULK1 kinase complex. Used to study triple-receptor negative breast cancer. Orthologous to human ULK3 (unc-51 like kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852696.name: TOS3
852696.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in cellular response to glucose starvation and regulation of protein localization to nucleus. Located in peroxisome. Orthologous to several human genes including CAMKK2 (calcium/calmodulin dependent protein kinase kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852697.name: MPT5
852697.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in intracellular mRNA localization; post-transcriptional regulation of gene expression; and regulation of G1 to G0 transition. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852709.name: PMR1
852709.summary: Enables P-type calcium transporter activity; P-type manganese transporter activity; and calcium ion binding activity. Involved in intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis; macroautophagy; and metal ion transport. Located in Golgi membrane. Used to study Hailey-Hailey disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Hailey-Hailey disease. Orthologous to human ATP2C1 (ATPase secretory pathway Ca2+ transporting 1) and ATP2C2 (ATPase secretory pathway Ca2+ transporting 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852724.name: PEX14
852724.summary: Enables protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix, docking and protein import into peroxisome matrix, translocation. Located in peroxisomal membrane. Part of peroxisomal importomer complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in peroxisome biogenesis disorder 13A. Orthologous to human PEX14 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 14). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852730.name: RPL9A
852730.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL9 (ribosomal protein L9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852742.name: RPL1B
852742.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL10A (ribosomal protein L10a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852744.name: ITC1
852744.summary: Involved in cellular response to pheromone; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in nucleus. Part of CHRAC. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852763.name: SNF4
852763.description: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase regulatory subunit SNF4
852763.otherdesignations: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase regulatory subunit SNF4
852763.nomenclaturename: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase regulatory subunit SNF4
852763.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity. Contributes to AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of gluconeogenesis; regulation of cellular response to glucose starvation; and regulation of invasive growth in response to glucose limitation. Located in cytoplasm; nuclear envelope lumen; and plasma membrane. Part of nucleotide-activated protein kinase complex. Used to study Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome and lethal congenital glycogen storage disease of heart. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome; glycogen storage disease; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy 6; and lethal congenital glycogen storage disease of heart. Orthologous to several human genes including PRKAG1 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit gamma 1) and PRKAG3 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit gamma 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852771.name: RMD9
852771.summary: Enables mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity. Involved in aerobic respiration; gene expression; and regulation of RNA metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852783.name: TOS8
852783.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromatin. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alcohol dependence. Orthologous to human PKNOX1 (PBX/knotted 1 homeobox 1) and PKNOX2 (PBX/knotted 1 homeobox 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852795.name: LCL3
852795.summary: Predicted to enable RNA endonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA catabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852800.name: MPC1
852800.summary: Enables pyruvate transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in pyruvate import into mitochondria. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane and peroxisome. Part of mitochondrial pyruvate carrier complex. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial pyruvate carrier deficiency. Orthologous to human MPC1 (mitochondrial pyruvate carrier 1) and MPC1L (mitochondrial pyruvate carrier 1 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852802.name: DBP3
852802.summary: Enables RNA helicase activity. Involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 upstream of 5.8S rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Located in nucleolus. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human DDX43 (DEAD-box helicase 43) and DDX53 (DEAD-box helicase 53). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852803.name: HNM1
852803.summary: Enables (R)-carnitine transmembrane transporter activity; choline transmembrane transporter activity; and ethanolamine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in amino-acid betaine transport; choline transport; and ethanolamine transport. Located in plasma membrane. Used to study proliferative vasculopathy and hydranencephaly-hydrocephaly syndrome. Orthologous to human SLC7A1 (solute carrier family 7 member 1); SLC7A2 (solute carrier family 7 member 2); and SLC7A3 (solute carrier family 7 member 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852804.name: RPL7A
852804.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation and maturation of LSU-rRNA. Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL7 (ribosomal protein L7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852814.name: SGF73
852814.summary: Enables enzyme activator activity and structural molecule activity. Contributes to histone acetyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including mRNA export from nucleus; positive regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription preinitiation complex assembly; and regulation of protein localization to chromatin. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of DUBm complex; SAGA complex; and SLIK (SAGA-like) complex. Used to study spinocerebellar ataxia 7. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spinocerebellar ataxia 7. Orthologous to human ATXN7 (ataxin 7); ATXN7L1 (ataxin 7 like 1); and ATXN7L2 (ataxin 7 like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852816.name: MRH4
852816.summary: Enables RNA helicase activity and mitochondrial ribosomal large subunit rRNA binding activity. Involved in RNA metabolic process and mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit assembly. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Orthologous to human DDX28 (DEAD-box helicase 28). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852824.name: SDS23
852824.summary: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine phosphatase inhibitor activity. Involved in septum digestion after cytokinesis. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852833.name: TIF4632
852833.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity; translation initiation factor activity; and translation initiation factor binding activity. Involved in cellular response to glucose starvation; stress granule assembly; and translational initiation. Located in P-body and cytoplasmic stress granule. Part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex. Orthologous to human EIF4G2 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4 gamma 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852834.name: RPT6
852834.description: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT6
852834.otherdesignations: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT6
852834.nomenclaturename: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT6
852834.summary: Enables protein domain specific binding activity and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including nonfunctional rRNA decay; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and proteasome regulatory particle assembly. Located in nucleus and proteasome storage granule. Part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Used to study Alzheimer's disease; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; cancer; inclusion body myopathy with Paget disease of bone and frontotemporal dementia; and myopathy. Orthologous to human PSMC5 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852837.name: RIM8
852837.summary: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in cellular response to amino acid stimulus and ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis. Located in cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including ARRDC1 (arrestin domain containing 1); ARRDC2 (arrestin domain containing 2); and ARRDC3 (arrestin domain containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852846.name: PNC1
852846.summary: Enables nicotinamidase activity. Involved in heterochromatin formation; negative regulation of DNA amplification; and nicotinate nucleotide salvage. Located in nucleus and peroxisome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852848.name: MIG1
852848.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; positive regulation of filamentous growth of a population of unicellular organisms in response to starvation; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm and nuclear envelope lumen. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852874.name: MPO1
852874.summary: Enables fatty acid alpha-dioxygenase activity. Involved in fatty acid alpha-oxidation and sphingoid catabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852881.name: CDH1
852881.summary: Enables cyclin binding activity and ubiquitin ligase activator activity. Involved in positive regulation of anaphase-promoting complex-dependent catabolic process and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of anaphase-promoting complex. Used to study disease of cellular proliferation. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 109. Orthologous to human FZR1 (fizzy and cell division cycle 20 related 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852902.name: UGA1
852902.summary: Enables 4-aminobutyrate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity. Involved in GABA catabolic process. Located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease; GABA aminotransferase deficiency; and Huntington's disease. Orthologous to human ABAT (4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852925.name: ACB1
852925.summary: Enables long-chain fatty acyl-CoA binding activity. Involved in very long-chain fatty acid biosynthetic process. Located in extracellular region. Used to study cardiovascular system disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alcohol dependence. Orthologous to several human genes including DBI (diazepam binding inhibitor, acyl-CoA binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852931.name: KSS1
852931.summary: Enables MAP kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion; and signal transduction involved in filamentous growth. Located in cellular bud neck and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome 13; Parkinson's disease; carcinoma (multiple); melanoma; and pulmonary hypertension. Orthologous to human MAPK1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 1) and MAPK3 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852948.name: LST7
852948.summary: Contributes to GTPase activator activity. Involved in cellular response to amino acid stimulus and positive regulation of TORC1 signaling. Located in vacuolar membrane. Part of FNIP-folliculin RagC/D GAP. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome; colorectal cancer; primary spontaneous pneumothorax; and renal cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human FLCN (folliculin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852952.name: ADE6
852952.summary: Enables phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase activity. Involved in purine nucleotide biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human PFAS (phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852955.name: SPT4
852955.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II complex binding activity and rDNA binding activity. Contributes to single-stranded RNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including RNA metabolic process; regulation of gene expression; and regulation of transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair. Located in chromosome and nucleus. Part of DSIF complex. Orthologous to human SUPT4H1 (SPT4 homolog, DSIF elongation factor subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852962.name: ENV11
852962.summary: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in vacuolar protein processing and vacuole organization. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852963.name: UPF3
852963.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Involved in DNA recombination; nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, 3'-5' exonucleolytic nonsense-mediated decay; and protein ubiquitination. Located in cytoplasm and nucleolus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 14. Orthologous to human UPF3A (UPF3A regulator of nonsense mediated mRNA decay) and UPF3B (UPF3B regulator of nonsense mediated mRNA decay). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852969.name: PAC10
852969.summary: Enables tubulin binding activity. Involved in tubulin complex assembly. Located in cytoplasm. Part of prefoldin complex. Used to study cancer. Orthologous to human VBP1 (VHL binding protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852971.name: TWF1
852971.summary: Enables actin filament binding activity; actin monomer binding activity; and protein sequestering activity. Involved in actin cytoskeleton organization; actin filament severing; and positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization. Located in actin filament. Orthologous to human TWF1 (twinfilin actin binding protein 1) and TWF2 (twinfilin actin binding protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852979.name: CTT1
852979.summary: Enables catalase activity. Involved in response to reactive oxygen species. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including acatalasia; eye disease (multiple); lung disease (multiple); osteonecrosis; and pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Orthologous to human CAT (catalase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852984.name: DBF2
852984.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including regulation of cytokinesis; regulation of protein localization to cell division site; and vacuolar acidification. Located in cellular bud neck and spindle pole body. Part of Sid2-Mob1 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852988.name: TPC1
852988.summary: Enables thiamine pyrophosphate transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in mitochondrial thiamine pyrophosphate transmembrane transport. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inherited metabolic disorder and microcephaly. Orthologous to human SLC25A19 (solute carrier family 25 member 19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852993.name: PCP1
852993.summary: Enables serine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in protein maturation and regulation of mitochondrion organization. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber hereditary optic neuropathy; coronary artery disease; hyperinsulinism; myopia; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human PARL (presenilin associated rhomboid like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852997.name: VMA21
852997.summary: Involved in vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex assembly. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Used to study X-linked myopathy with excessive autophagy and follicular lymphoma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked myopathy with excessive autophagy. Orthologous to human VMA21 (vacuolar ATPase assembly factor VMA21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853002.name: CLB1
853002.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in cell cycle G2/M phase transition; mitotic spindle organization; and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of cyclin-dependent protein kinase holoenzyme complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human CCNB1 (cyclin B1) and CCNB2 (cyclin B2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853009.name: SHY1
853009.summary: Enables unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study Leigh disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4K; Leigh disease; and mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 1. Orthologous to human SURF1 (SURF1 cytochrome c oxidase assembly factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853031.name: YGR130C
853031.summary: Involved in cellular response to glucose starvation and protein localization to eisosome filament. Located in cytoplasm. Is active in eisosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853033.name: PHB1
853033.summary: Contributes to mitochondrion autophagosome adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including inner mitochondrial membrane organization; mitochondrion inheritance; and mitophagy. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and sporadic breast cancer. Orthologous to human PHB1 (prohibitin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853036.name: PRE9
853036.summary: Involved in proteasomal ubiquitin-independent protein catabolic process; proteasome core complex assembly; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in proteasome storage granule. Part of proteasome core complex, alpha-subunit complex. Orthologous to human PSMA4 (proteasome 20S subunit alpha 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853037.name: LSB1
853037.summary: Involved in negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation. Located in actin cortical patch. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; prostate adenocarcinoma; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human GRB2 (growth factor receptor bound protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853042.name: VPS62
853042.summary: Involved in protein targeting to vacuole. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and fungal-type vacuole membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853045.name: SKN1
853045.summary: Enables glucosidase activity. Involved in several processes, including (1->6)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process; fungal-type cell wall organization; and negative regulation of autophagy. Located in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853059.name: CYS4
853059.summary: Enables cystathionine beta-synthase activity. Involved in hydrogen sulfide biosynthetic process; transsulfuration; and traversing start control point of mitotic cell cycle. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule and mitochondrion. Is active in cytoplasm. Used to study Down syndrome; breast cancer; colon cancer; homocystinuria; and ovarian cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including cerebral infarction; homocystinuria; hyperhomocysteinemia; malaria; and neural tube defect. Orthologous to human CBS (cystathionine beta-synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853064.name: NSR1
853064.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; RNA binding activity; and nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Involved in DNA recombination and chromosome organization. Located in nuclear envelope. Orthologous to human NUCLEOLIN (nucleolin multifunctional protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853071.name: TIF4631
853071.summary: Enables ATPase activator activity; RNA binding activity; and molecular condensate scaffold activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose starvation; positive regulation of formation of translation preinitiation complex; and stress granule assembly. Located in P-body and cytoplasmic stress granule. Part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in late onset Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including EIF4G2 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4 gamma 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853085.name: CBP4
853085.summary: Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly. Located in mitochondrial membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853118.name: ADE3
853118.description: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase ADE3
853118.otherdesignations: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase ADE3
853118.nomenclaturename: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase ADE3
853118.summary: Enables formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase activity; methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase activity; and methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in folic acid-containing compound metabolic process and purine nucleobase biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Down syndrome; abdominal aortic aneurysm; cleft lip; developmental cardiac valvular defect; and neural tube defect (multiple). Orthologous to human MTHFD1L (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+ dependent) 1 like) and MTHFD1 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase, cyclohydrolase and formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853135.name: MRPL9
853135.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 9. Orthologous to human MRPL3 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853142.name: DIE2
853142.summary: Enables dolichyl pyrophosphate Glc2Man9GlcNAc2 alpha-1,2-glucosyltransferase activity. Involved in dolichol-linked oligosaccharide biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in long QT syndrome 2. Orthologous to several human genes including ALG10 (ALG10 alpha-1,2-glucosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853144.name: SMI1
853144.summary: Involved in regulation of fungal-type cell wall biogenesis and regulation of mitotic cell cycle. Located in cellular bud neck and incipient cellular bud site. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853146.name: PHB2
853146.summary: Contributes to mitochondrion autophagosome adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including mitochondrion inheritance; mitophagy; and protein folding. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to human PHB2 (prohibitin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853159.name: LSC2
853159.summary: Contributes to succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity. Involved in succinyl-CoA metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 5. Orthologous to human SUCLA2 (succinate-CoA ligase ADP-forming subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853165.name: RIE1
853165.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Acts upstream of or within negative regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853167.name: GCN5
853167.summary: Enables histone modifying activity; histone reader activity; and transcription coregulator activity. Involved in chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromosome, centromeric region; cytosol; and nucleus. Part of ADA complex; SAGA complex; and SLIK (SAGA-like) complex. Orthologous to several human genes including KAT2A (lysine acetyltransferase 2A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853173.name: MTM1
853173.summary: Enables pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Involved in intracellular iron ion homeostasis and pyridoxal phosphate transport. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human SLC25A39 (solute carrier family 25 member 39) and SLC25A40 (solute carrier family 25 member 40). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853186.name: YTA7
853186.summary: Enables several functions, including ATP hydrolysis activity; ATP-dependent histone chaperone activity; and histone binding activity. Involved in several processes, including CENP-A containing chromatin assembly; nucleosome disassembly; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromosome, centromeric region; cytosol; and nucleus. Is active in chromatin. Used to study breast cancer and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human ATAD2 (ATPase family AAA domain containing 2) and ATAD2B (ATPase family AAA domain containing 2B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853198.name: YOR1
853198.summary: Enables ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity. Involved in xenobiotic transport. Located in plasma membrane. Used to study cystic fibrosis. Orthologous to human ABCC12 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 12) and ABCC5 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853219.name: PEX2
853219.summary: Enables transmembrane protein transporter activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix and protein ubiquitination. Part of peroxisomal importomer complex. Is active in peroxisomal membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 5B and peroxisome biogenesis disorder 5A. Orthologous to human PEX2 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853226.name: RCY1
853226.summary: Enables SNARE binding activity. Involved in early endosome to Golgi transport; endocytic recycling; and endocytosis. Located in Golgi apparatus; endosome; and site of polarized growth. Orthologous to human EXOC5 (exocyst complex component 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853230.name: ACO2
853230.summary: Predicted to enable 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity and aconitate hydratase activity. Involved in tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853244.name: CDC6
853244.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA replication origin binding activity; purine ribonucleoside triphosphate binding activity; and ribonucleoside triphosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity; and nuclear DNA replication. Located in cytoplasm. Part of DNA replication preinitiation complex and nuclear pre-replicative complex. Is active in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Meier-Gorlin syndrome 5. Orthologous to human CDC6 (cell division cycle 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853250.name: RPL39
853250.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL39 (ribosomal protein L39); RPL39L (ribosomal protein L39 like); and RPL39P5 (ribosomal protein L39 pseudogene 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853252.name: SWE1
853252.summary: Enables protein tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle; positive regulation of sphingolipid biosynthetic process; and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in cellular bud neck and nucleus. Orthologous to human PKMYT1 (protein kinase, membrane associated tyrosine/threonine 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853262.name: RPL17B
853262.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cleavage in ITS2 between 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human RPL17 (ribosomal protein L17). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853267.name: CPS1
853267.summary: Enables carboxypeptidase activity. Involved in protein catabolic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole lumen. Orthologous to human PM20D1 (peptidase M20 domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853271.name: SET2
853271.summary: Enables RNA binding activity and histone H3K36 methyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated transcription; negative regulation of antisense RNA transcription; and regulation of DNA metabolic process. Acts upstream of or within transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 70; clear cell renal cell carcinoma; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung disease (multiple); and malignant mesothelioma (multiple). Orthologous to human SETD2 (SET domain containing 2, histone lysine methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853273.name: QCR8
853273.summary: Enables quinol-cytochrome-c reductase activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 4. Orthologous to human UQCRQ (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex III subunit VII). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853275.name: TPK1
853275.description: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK1
853275.otherdesignations: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK1
853275.nomenclaturename: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK1
853275.summary: Enables cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including Ras protein signal transduction; negative regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly; and protein import into nucleus. Acts upstream of or within double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining. Located in chromatin; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Part of cAMP-dependent protein kinase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adrenal cortical adenoma; congestive heart failure; fibrolamellar carcinoma; platelet-type bleeding disorder 19; and primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease 4. Orthologous to several human genes including PRKACA (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha); PRKACB (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit beta); and PRKACG (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853290.name: SNA3
853290.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway and protein catabolic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole lumen. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
